title: Explore
why: It is the page that answers «what happened today», and it is the one screen in this app whose fold was demonstrably moving under the reader while the data landed.

measurements.note: This one is not against the reference at all — it is ours against ours, one composition photographed either side of the catalogue landing. A steady-state golden cannot see it: both frames are individually correct and the fault is the difference between them. ExploreGeometryTest asserts the same thing in points; this asserts it in pixels on a real device.
